quantum.kernel: Actual FidelityQuantumKernel/QMLSampler analytic compute-uncompute, enforce_psd=False, linear ZZ

information_policy: All three folds are previously inspected development folds; no independent confirmation, final2019-2024 reads or model promotion. SCANFI full-series future imagery blocks as-of forecasts. Strict prior-epoch species and previous-year incident-count joins; first lag missing and train-median imputed. Six extra weather columns are already audited ECCC aggregates, not added independent years.
optimization_policy: Optimize normalized expected training QUBO, one frozen start per depth with bounded COBYLA48/72 evaluations. Phase scale is feasible energy range, recorded physical gamma=normalized gamma/range. No validation-driven parameters, feature order or choice selection. Canonical nested order; downstream selected indices ascending.
resource_policy: Classical exact cardinality-sector simulation of logical10/16/20-qubit XY-QAOA; small-circuit Qiskit parity checked. Real qiskit-addon-sqd projection/eigensolver checks on representative1024 shots per policy/cohort. All sample draws classical; no new QiskitSampler/hardware. Optimizer observes all feasible costs/probabilities, making quantum speedup impossible to infer. Report costs/exact enumeration and generic initialization not implemented for larger hardware.
sampling_policy: Uniform-feasible, fixed p1, optimized p1 and p2 each use20 paired Monte Carlo seeds at256/1024 samples. Save every count; repeats assess sampling variability, not independent climate realizations. Predictors use one predeclared1024-sample seed per fold/pool/policy, plus MI/exact controls, same four selected inputs/models.
sqd_policy: Diagonal QUBO: SQD eigenvalue equals minimum observed cost; it supplies no additional optimization beyond the sampling distribution.
